title: Enforce page visibility rules in static docs publishing
description:
Problem: runtime page/page-asset APIs enforce page visibility, but the static docs generator currently renders every markdown file under Data/Pages and copies every non-markdown file into docs/output/wiki. Current page sidecars include Admin-only pages, so the GitHub Pages export can publish content that the live app would hide behind Admin page visibility.

Evidence from the 2026-05-25 deepdive:
- docs/build_pages_site.py builds page_files = sorted(PAGES_DIR.rglob("*.md")) with no sidecar visibility filter.
- docs/build_pages_site.py copy_pages_assets() copies every non-.md file under Data/Pages, which includes .page.json sidecars.
- Data/Pages/features/admin-and-auth.page.json and Data/Pages/features/proposals-and-governance.page.json currently set minimumRole to Admin.
- Runtime /page-assets serving in Program.cs checks FilePageService.GetAssetAccessInfoAsync and has tests, but the static generator is a separate publication path.

Desired outcome: static publication must make an explicit visibility decision instead of silently publishing every page and metadata sidecar. The safest default is to publish only Anonymous pages/assets unless a deliberate internal-docs build mode is requested.

Scope:
- In scope: teach docs/build_pages_site.py to read .page.json sidecars, exclude non-Anonymous pages by default, avoid copying .page.json metadata, and copy only assets referenced by included pages or explicitly safe static assets.
- In scope: document the static docs visibility rule in the wiki health/docs publishing runbook.
- Out of scope: changing runtime page visibility semantics.

Acceptance criteria:
- Static docs export excludes Admin and Authenticated pages by default.
- Static docs export does not publish .page.json sidecars.
- Asset copying cannot leak assets referenced only by excluded pages.
- A deliberate opt-in flag exists if an internal all-pages export is needed, and it is clearly labeled as non-public.
- Tests or a script-level validation fixture covers Anonymous, Authenticated, and Admin page sidecars plus asset-copy behavior.

Validation:
- Run the static docs build and verify excluded pages/sidecars/assets are absent from docs/output/wiki.
- Run ./Scripts/Test-PageLinks.ps1 and ./Scripts/Test-PagePathLiterals.ps1 after docs/runbook updates.
- Run ./Scripts/Test-TaskRecords.ps1 after task metadata changes.
